messages:
Maya: kicking off Porto embeddings bring-up on staging. ran contrastive holdout + recall@k sweep for float32, int8, int6. quick summary below, logs in GCS. asking for eyeballs on the int6 drop
Liam: nice — quick numbers?
Maya: baseline float32 recall@10 = 0.873, int8 = 0.868, int6 = 0.849 (same eval split). int6 seems to lose ~2.4 absolute points vs float32.
Sara: hmm that's larger than we've seen for other models at int6. what's the quant toolchain? per-channel symmetric?
Maya: using our usual onnx-quantize -> per-channel affine with clamp trick. command I ran:
Maya: ```bash
./quantize_model --model porto-v1.onnx --scheme per-channel --calib-samples 2048 --out porto-v1-int6.onnx
```
Liam: can you paste the evaluation breakdown by query length / cluster density? might be a short-seq problem
Maya: pasted snippet from eval bot below (truncated):
EvalBot: Porto-v1 eval summary:
- overall recall@10: float32 0.873 | int8 0.868 | int6 0.849
- short queries (<16 tokens) recall@10: float32 0.815 | int6 0.771
- long queries (>128 tokens) recall@10: float32 0.905 | int6 0.896
- average cosine shift (float32 vs int6): 0.042
- top-1 rank swap rate: 3.6%
Sara: short queries hit worse, suggests quant noise on prefix tokens. maybe per-token norm stats differ. did you run per-layer bias folding?
Maya: yes bias folding on. I also tried per-tensor symmetric and saw slightly worse.
Liam: can you re-run with KV-cache disabled for the eval? there was an issue where quantized kv scaling introduced tiny offsets for short contexts
Maya: will try. also going to try calibration sample stratification (more short queries in calibrator).
Maya: quick run result (after stratified calib + kv-disabled): int6 recall@10 improved to 0.857 — up 0.8 points.
Sara: that's promising. do you have cluster-level silhouette / purity? could be that nearest neighbors get re-ranked locally
Maya: cluster purity (kmeans 50) float32 = 0.62, int6 = 0.59, stratified-calib int6 = 0.605
Liam: ok so stratified calib recovers ~half the degradation. suggests calibration distribution matters a lot for this model.
Maya: logging an action item: try per-channel with 4096 calib, and a variant with clamp removed. also run recall@1/5/10 and embedding cosine hist diffs.
Maya: CC @Sara can you run a small ablation on layerwise quant (exclude first attn/wte or last MLP) to see sensitivity?
Sara: on it, will run 3 quick variants and post results in this thread.
EvalBot: scheduled nightly long-sweep: porto-v1 {float32,int8,int6} x splits {short,long,random} -> uploads to GCS://redwood-evals/porto/nightly/56321/
ops-bot: deploy note: staging pods autoscaled to 8 for porto-int6 smoke run, rolled back to baseline after test :white_check_mark:
Liam: thanks — good triage. if ablations show a handful of sensitive layers we can keep them in higher precision and still save cost. :thumbsup:
Maya: thanks team — will update with ablation outputs and a short PR for the quant pipeline changes.
